Use case: precise-object-edit.
Develop the SELECTED A spell-card frame into a refined, substantial, carefully made MAGIC CARD. This is a color/material refinement of the supplied frame, not a different frame design.
PRESERVE the exact outer silhouette, frame-band width, double-line structure, cut corners, inner art opening, proportions and layout of the reference. The frame must remain visibly present with its layered edge definition; do not erase or flatten it into a bare outline. All three spell classes must still be instantly distinct.
AUTHORIZED CHANGES:
1. Recolor the existing PALE FRAME BAND to rich low-saturation dark ink-brown #51463F, with the exterior contour #2B2929 and a very narrow, controlled gray-gold edge highlight #AD9A7D. Deep color belongs to the frame BAND, not a thicker black outline and not the paper center.
2. Replace distressed old-paper styling with fine, strong, carefully finished enchanted cardstock. Remove cracks, splits, jagged breaks, dirt spots, corner damage and most crosshatching. Keep a little intentional hand-drawn line-weight variation and very subtle clean paper fibers. All edges complete and intact, no curling or peeling anywhere.
3. Refine existing double-lines into clean continuous hand-inked lines, with just a few precise short ornamental incisions inside the frame band at selected corners. Small craft details only, not large ornaments. Preserve the same visual frame width. A restrained satin edge catchlight suggests care and latent magic without glowing neon. It should look elegant and alive, not decayed, brittle, metallic armor, a wooden picture frame, or a photorealistic 3D object.
The entire paper center remains BLANK and OPAQUE PALE WARM GRAY: subtle vertical top #E5DCC9, midpoint #DDD3BE, bottom #D4C7AD. No radial vignette, no yellow aging, no spots or cracks across the art opening. Leave at least75% of face open. No central illustration, text, numbers, crest, seal, glowing magic circle, runic wallpaper or elemental color coding. No whole-frame blue/purple glow, no gems, no curls. The lower-right corner stays quiet for a future mechanism badge.
Style: high-quality original gothic survival storybook illustration, precise yet handmade ink linework, rich matte dark border against luminous pale paper, crisp details. Keep it a physical thin card. Dark border is subordinate to the future colored spell illustration.
Input image1 is the EDIT TARGET, the A comparison board. Keep its entire layout: top three large collection cards BASIC (clipped rectangle), MODIFIER (vertical six-sided pointed hexagon), CONTROL (clipped rectangle with a broad actual cutout in the top center). Preserve the actual notch cutout and the pointed hexagon. Lower left three inventory examples; lower right a lying-flat ground card and a short stack, with near edge wider than far edge and thin front paper layers.
Apply the new dark, refined material consistently to all examples. Collection cards may show the tiny clean incisions. Inventory versions use a strong simple dark band, a clear outline and one narrow highlight with no tiny incisions. Ground is similarly simplified, maintaining thin flat paper and restrained attached ground shadow.
Keep the quiet dark background, layout, sizes and labels. Change only the top title to exactly "A — REFINED SPELL CARDS". Preserve labels "COLLECTION", "BASIC", "MODIFIER", "CONTROL", "INVENTORY", "GROUND". No additional text. High-resolution polished comparison sheet, all card centers blank.
